headline: Weak Earnings Outlook Heightens Pressure on Bearish Chinese Stocks
summary: Slowing profit growth across consumer goods, real estate, and green energy sectors is weighing on Chinese equities.
why: Chinese stock exchanges track corporate performance across the world's second-largest economy.

impacts.name: Chinese Equities
impacts.why: Third-quarter profit growth slowed across mainland listed firms compared to the first half.

why_moved: Chinese stocks faced downward pressure as Q3 earnings growth slowed across multiple sectors.
